text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is finally the day of the Japan Cup. 
Steeling my resolve, I headed to the 
racetrack in the morning—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Grass Wonder-san! Good morning to 
your Trainer as well!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! You're that reporter who visits so 
often, aren't you? Good morning to you~."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well~ I definitely can't miss watching the 
"Second Generation" run!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it...! Have either of 
you seen this online article!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: An online article?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reporter showed me a well-known news 
site that publishes predictions for the 
participating Umamusume in the Arima Kinen 
every year.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the Arima Kinen, it's a grand 
stage where only the truly elite gather, 
chosen by fan votes from both the Classic 
and Senior classes!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
In the participant predictions for that 
race, incredibly...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...So it's my name and Maruzen-san's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder had been gaining experience 
through the Classic races all for the sake 
of facing Maruzensky head-on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that the race meant to be the 
decisive showdown is...!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To share the turf with you at the Arima 
Kinen... is an honor, Senpai. Hehe~

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, everyone is watching you through 
Maruzensky-san!! And personally, I'm 
looking forward to it immensely as well!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I have high expectations for 
today's race too! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...It's about that time, isn't it?
choice_data_list: We're all set, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's right—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, El. Did you come to pick me up~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes! I have come to guide you, desu!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to guide you straight to the ring 
of my glorious victoryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my, my. Isn't your destination a 
little off track?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I shall forge ahead. Bearing the name of 
the "Second-Generation Monster"...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And beyond that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Ahead, is it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Well, very well!! Come, Grass, hurry to 
the paddock!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Trainer, I'm off.
